messages:
Maya Patel: Quick heads-up — Microdrop cohort B has 6 customers booked next Wed 9am-12pm PST. Need hosts + short runbook + a buffer plan. Who can take which slot? :wave:
Sam Ortega: I can host 9:00-9:45 (intake + quick demo). happy to own slide walkthrough. @Rajiv can you take the next block?
Rajiv Menon: Yep 10:00-10:45 works for me. I'll prep two short prompts and a slide with config screenshots.
Eli Zhao: I can cover 11:00-11:45 and join as SME on quantization/latency questions. :thumbsup:
Maya Patel: Proposed structure: three 45m customer blocks with 15m triage/buffer in between. Slots: 09:00-09:45 / 10:00-10:45 / 11:00-11:45. Need host for each "room" + waiting-room triage. Calendar draft: https://cal.example.com/microdrop-cohortB (internal)
Sam Ortega: I'll take Room A 09:00-09:45. Can someone own the waiting-room queue and quick infra triage? Billing questions should be routed to CSMs, but basic quota errors we can triage.
Rajiv Menon: I'll own the buffer triage 09:45-10:00 and 10:45-11:00 (quick queue). Taking Room B 10:00-10:45.
Maya Patel: Rota recap: Sam (9-9:45), Rajiv (10-10:45), Eli (11-11:45). Backup: @Lena Torres if someone gets pulled. @scheduler-bot can you create the invites and attach the prep doc? :calendar:
scheduler-bot: Created calendar events and invited hosts + customers. Prep doc: https://docs.example.com/microdrop-cohortB-prep. Events will include join links and buffer windows.
Lena Torres: I can back up 09:00-11:00 if needed. Ping me 2 hours before if you expect overlap.
Rajiv Menon: Mini-runbook (paste):
```
Microdrop cohort B runbook v1
- 15m before: confirm host + deck loaded, open breakout rooms, verify customer org id
- Intake (first 5m): capture use-case, latency/cost SLO, current infra
- Demo (20m): guided prompts, show perf dashboard, highlight config
- Troubleshoot (10m): common fixes (batching, kv-cache, quant profile)
- Close (5m): next steps, link to feedback form, assign follow-up owner
Escalation path:
- If tokenization/model mismatch => ping eng-ml on-call
- If infra/credentials => escalate to eng-infra
- Renewal-risk flags => tag CSM and add to renewal tracker
```
Sam Ortega: Adding feedback capture: short form (1-2 mins) — https://forms.example.com/microdrop-feedback. We'll ask: 1) How useful was the session (1-5), 2) What stopped you from going faster?, 3) One improvement request. Please paste link to follow-up email.
Eli Zhao: Note on renewal risk: if customer reports repeated latency spikes, error budget breaches, or requests for private deployment due to compliance, mark as HIGH risk and loop CSM + AE immediately. We'll add a "renewal_flag" tag in the tracker.
Maya Patel: Awesome — final asks: drop your slide deck links in this thread, confirm your slot by EOD, and if you want me to draft the follow-up email I can. :rocket:
